mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.parent_id, d.name, d.sort, COUNT(DISTINCT ud.user_id) AS user_count FROM sys_dept d LEFT JOIN sys_dept sd ON sd.is_deleted = 0 AND sd.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND (sd.id = d.id OR sd.tree_path LIKE CONCAT(d.tree_path, ',%')) LEFT JOIN sys_user_dept ud ON ud.is_deleted = 0 AND ud.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND ud.dept_id = sd.id WHERE d.is_deleted = 0 AND d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} GROUP BY d.id, d.parent_id, d.name, d.sort ORDER BY d.sort ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_dept SET tree_path = CONCAT(#{newPrefix}, SUBSTRING(tree_path, #{oldPrefixLen})) WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND tree_path LIKE CONCAT(#{oldPrefix}, ',%')
